Maria Chen: Quick sync — following yesterday's postmortem for the analytics gaps, I want to align owners and concrete timelines for the fixes (missing spans, bad aggregation, ETL lag). Can folks volunteer to own each remediations list?

Dan Vogel: I'll take the aggregation pipeline fix (root cause was the sharded reducer dropping keys when load spiked). Plan: patch reducer logic, add unit tests, and add a nightly aggregation validation job. Target: PR by Wed EOD. :thumbsup:

Ash Patel: I can own the ETL lag work. Initial hypothesis is the backfill job queue got starved by a misconfigured concurrency limiter. I'll audit the scheduler config and add instrumentation to track queue depth. Target: config rollout + metrics by Thu.

Leo Zhang: I can pick up the missing spans reconciliation. I want to add a detection job that compares counts between raw ingestion and trace-joins every 10m, and backfill any gaps automatically. Will prototype a query and small worker. ETA: spike by Tue.

Priya Rao: For prioritization — can we map expected customer impact per fix? Also we should surface these to CS for customers who saw dashboards anomaly. I'll draft the customer-facing note once owners confirm scope.

Dan Vogel: +1 on the validation job. Proposed SQL for nightly check (example):
```
WITH raw_counts AS (
  SELECT service, count(1) AS raw_ct FROM spans_raw WHERE ingest_ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY service
), joined_counts AS (
  SELECT service, count(1) AS joined_ct FROM spans_joined WHERE join_ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY service
)
SELECT r.service, raw_ct, coalesce(joined_ct,0) AS joined_ct, raw_ct - coalesce(joined_ct,0) AS delta
FROM raw_counts r LEFT JOIN joined_counts j ON r.service = j.service
WHERE raw_ct - coalesce(joined_ct,0) > 100
ORDER BY delta DESC;
```

Maria Chen: Nice. Add that to the PR description so QA can run it against staging. Also we should add an alert threshold to paging channel for deltas > 500 for any svc.

Ash Patel: On ETL concurrency — current scheduler config is `max_workers=64` but the job pool is capped by `max_inflight_per_worker=1`. That means spikes exhaust the pool. Proposed fix: increase inflight to 3 and add token-bucket throttle at the queue ingress. Will test in canary.

sre-bot: alert muted:observability:analytics-delta > 500 at 2026-02-10T11:42:15Z (automated)

Leo Zhang: For backfill size, I estimated ~12M spans missing for the largest service. Backfill plan: chunked workers, idempotent writes, and a progress table to resume. I'll post the chunking script in the PR.

Dan Vogel: Owners + rough timeline summary: Aggregation (Dan) — PR by Wed, canary Thu, prod Fri. ETL concurrency (Ash) — config audit Mon, canary Wed, rollout Fri. Reconciliation/backfill (Leo) — spike Tue, PR Thu, backfill weekend. Priya to coordinate customer comms and SLO owners.

Priya Rao: I can own the comms and the SLO impact doc. Will prepare a short summary + FAQ for CS by Thu.

Maria Chen: Great. I'll create a small tracking doc with these action items and link it in the postmortem. Two more asks: (1) add a post-rollback test for aggregation (so we detect regressions), (2) set up a weekly check for this class of errors for 6 weeks to see recurrence.

Ash Patel: Agreed on weekly checks. I'll add a dashboard panel for queue depth + backoff errors.

Dan Vogel: Adding unit/regression tests for the reducer now. Quick note: we should also add a canary flag that routes 5% of traffic to the new reducer impl to catch corner cases.

Maria Chen: Thanks everyone. Action owners: Dan, Ash, Leo, Priya. I'll follow up with a calendar sync tomorrow for daily stand during the sprint window. If anything slips, drop notes here with updated ETA. :rocket:
